From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Date: 2028-05-23T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier setup request: MediCore (ClearLine Health)

Hi Sara — thanks for the packet, and welcome. I briefly reviewed the COI and W-9; a few items before Procurement / AP can issue a PO: 

1) Endorsement: We need an Additional Insured endorsement on the Commercial General Liability naming “Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents" as Additional Insured.
2) Waiver/Primary: For Professional Liability / Errors & Omissions, we request a primary/non-contributory clause where available; for Cyber, Redwood requests notification and name Redwood as a loss payee where applicable (we can accept a primary/non-contributory endorsement or a carrier letter that commits to not seek contribution).
3) Subcontractor disclosure: Please provide a short list of any subcontractors that will handle PHI or customer data.
4) Effective limits: GL 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate minimum; Cyber limit >= 1M preferred.

If you can get the broker to add the Additional Insured endorsement and re-issue the COI (or attach the separate endorsement form), Procurement can create a conditional PO. Procurement will queue a PO number but hold issuance until we confirm the signed endorsement and portal registration.

Next steps: If you send the endorsement file I will route to Marissa in procurement to create PO stub. If the endorsement is delayed beyond 72 hours let us know and we can consider a temporary conditional PO with limited spend.

Attached is an example endorsement template if helpful: https://drive.redwood.com/procurement/templates/endorsement-sample.pdf

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Please let me know if you want us to loop legal for the cyber language; otherwise procurement can proceed once the endorsement is in place.

Aim to have the PO queued within 48 business hours.

Sara — thanks for the rapid broker action. If Legal needs to review anything on cyber language I will escalate; otherwise expect a conditional PO stub in the next business day and a request to complete vendor portal sign-up (I will send the portal link once Marissa confirms).

Grace O'Connor
